title: Injectivity of the encoding
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer and let $m$ be a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$. Encoding length-$\ell$ vectors as their low-coefficient polynomials in the quotient obtained by adjoining a root of $X^\ell+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$ is injective.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$
